remarks: This renovated 1BR condo makes it EZ for the new owner to move right in! This 1st floor end unit boasts a new HVAC system(2023), new HW heater(2024), new light fixtures(2024) plus SS appliances with newer ss refrigerator(2022). Reasonable monthly HOA dues! Reasonable utility costs! Laminate wood flooring. A stackable washer/dryer in the unit offers great convenience. 2 BR closets were converted to a large closet with organizers. Br sliders give access to your own private patio and nice common grassy area to relax! You can start counting the months before the pool will be open for next year's hot and humid summer days! Beautifully landscaped grounds. A reserved parking space plus visitor spaces available. Just a few minutes commute to Sono, RR, major shopping, restaurants, 95 and Merritt Pkwy. This condo has a lot to offer so compare to others! Also available for rent @ $2145.
